name: Elemental Transfiguration: Overload Blessing
title: Elemental Transfiguration: Overload Blessing
desc: "Lightning and fire bite as one, bursting forth in dazzling light."
in_play_description:
Roll Phase: Always roll 2 Electro Dice and 2 Pyro Dice.
After you trigger a Overloaded reaction: Discard this card, then choose either Overloaded: Pursuing Fire or Overloaded: Thunderstrike and add it to your Hand.
